title: 285. Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder Traversal

examples.explanation: The last postorder entry (3) is the root; it splits inorder into left [9] and right [15,20,7], then recursion finishes both sides.
A single entry in both walks describes a lone node.

Look that root value up in the inorder walk: everything left of it forms the left subtree, everything right forms the right subtree.
